If multiple operations are mapped to the same RunnableEn- tity , and [SWS_Rte_04522] requires a call serialization, then a single queue is imple- mented for invocations coming from any of the operations.

If multiple OperationInvokedEvent s start the same RunnableEntity , and they are mapped to the same position in the same task then the RTE shall implement a single queue for invocations coming from any of the opera- tions (i.e. it ensures that the RunnableEntity implementing the server operation has completed the processing of a request before it begins processing the next request).

If multiple OperationInvokedEvent s or BswOperationIn- vokedEvent s start the same server ExecutableEntity , and they are mapped to the same position in the same task or ISR2 (which is enforced by [SWS_Rte_CONSTR_03873]) then the RTE shall implement a single queue for invoca- tions coming from any of the operations (i.e. it ensures that the ExecutableEntity implementing the server operation has completed the processing of a request before it begins processing the next request).
